name: Right Click Menu Builder – Custom Context Menu Maker
author: Jose Varghese

sections.description:
Right Click Menu Builder is the ultimate solution for creating a professional Custom Context Menu for your website. Instead of the standard browser right-click options, you can now provide your visitors with helpful navigation shortcuts, branded links, and intuitive submenus.

This Right Click Menu Maker is designed for speed and ease of use. With a powerful drag-and-drop interface, you can reorder menu items, create nested submenus, and customize the design to match your brand—all without touching a single line of code.

Whether you want to improve your site’s User Experience (UX) or create a unique interaction for your web application, this plugin gives you complete control over the Right Click behavior on your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • Custom Right Click Menu: Completely override the default browser context menu.
  • Drag & Drop Builder: Easily organize and reorder your right-click menu items.
  • Nested Submenus: Create multi-level navigation for better organization.
  • Open in New Tab: Choose to open links in the same window or a new tab.
  • Full Design Control: Customize text colors, background colors, and font sizes.
  • Mobile & Touch Support: Optional long-press support for mobile devices.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for performance with minimal CSS and JS footprint.
  • Accessibility Ready: Full keyboard navigation support.

Use Cases

  • Fast Navigation: Add quick links to your most important pages.
  • Branding: Add your logo or custom actions to the right-click interface.
  • Shortcuts: Provide easy access to contact forms, social media, or search.
  • Advanced UX: Create specific actions for logged-in users or members.
    Easy to Use =
  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings > Right Click Menu
  3. Customize colors and font size
  4. Add your menu items and submenus using drag & drop
  5. Save your settings and enjoy your custom right-click menu!
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Right Click Menu Builder”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Go to Settings > Right Click Menu to start building.
sections.faq:
Can I disable the custom menu on mobile devices?

Yes! There’s a “Mobile Settings” option that allows you to disable the custom right-click menu on mobile and touch devices. When enabled, mobile users will see the default browser context menu instead.

Does this work on mobile devices?

Yes! The plugin includes touch support with long-press functionality for mobile devices. However, you can choose to disable it on mobile devices if you prefer users to have the default browser menu.

Can I add submenus?

Absolutely! Each main menu item can have multiple submenu items that you can add and organize using the drag & drop interface.

Is the plugin accessible?

Yes, the plugin includes full keyboard navigation support and follows accessibility best practices.

Will this affect my website’s performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. It only loads the necessary CSS and JavaScript files.

Can I control whether links open in new tabs?

Yes! Each menu item and submenu item has a “New Tab” checkbox that allows you to control whether the link opens in the same tab or a new tab.

Can I convert submenu items to main menu items?

Absolutely! Each submenu item has a “Convert to Menu” button that allows you to promote it to a main menu item with one click.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, you can customize the text color, background color, and font size of your custom menu through the settings page.

The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. If you experience any issues, please contact support.

Does it work with all themes?

The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. If you experience any issues, please contact support.

Currently, the custom menu appears site-wide. Future versions may include page-specific controls.

Is it translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready and includes proper text domains for all strings.
